Varied hours from Walmart to StarbucksCopy linkBookmark popoverRemoved from bookmarksClose popover Powered By 10 Sec 249.6K 9Trump declares 'evil won't prevail' in Easter message as Iran war rages onNext video inShareNextKEEP WATCHINGSkip Ad Trump declares 'evil won't prevail' in Easter message as Iran war rages onEaster is celebrated on Sunday, April 5, this year. Stores closing for Easter are Aldi, Costco, Sam’s Club, and Target. Stores that remain open but with modified hours are CVS, Ikea, Ulta Beauty, and Starbucks. Stores with hours that remain unchanged are Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods, Walmart, Wegmans and Lidl.
